title: auth: publish the ADR-0090 D12 administrator predicate (including delegated administrators) for callers outside plugin-auth
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Filing gate: **② a finding from a dispatched card.** cloud#3668 (Enterprise access-policy console, PR cloud#4019) previews who a candidate MFA level `administrators` would hold. The third kind of administrator in ADR-0090 D12 (a delegated administrator, a permission set with an `adminScope`) is judged only inside plugin-auth, so the console says `delegated_administrators_judged: false` and the catalog says it does not judge them (dev report cloud#3668 comment 6731941056). The cloud lane does not dispatch this; triage routes it.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：判断"谁算管理员"（含委派管理员）的逻辑只在 plugin-auth 内部用，企业版的锁定预览拿不到，只能少算委派管理员。
- 要做：把这个判断作为稳定的公开接口导出。
- 需要你做的：无，分诊定车道。

## Evidence (pin 6ed533f6)

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` L6651: `public async isMfaAdministrator(userId, organizationId)` carries `@internal Package-internal: read by the MFA gate at the administrators level`. Kind 3 goes through `OrganizationAccessPolicySource.isDelegatedAdministrator` (bound in `organization-access-policy-binding.ts`).
- `@objectstack/core` publishes only the two posture rungs (`resolveUserAuthzGrants`).

## Work

1. Publish the D12 predicate as a supported seam (on the `auth` service or as a core helper), with the same fail-closed reading: an unreadable delegated grant counts as an administrator.
2. Document it as the one reading for "is this user an administrator in this organization".

## Done when

- A caller outside plugin-auth can ask whether a user is an administrator in an organization under all three D12 kinds and gets the MFA gate's own answer; a test pins that both agree.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` "isMfaAdministrator" → none; "delegated administrator" → no publishing card (nearest #30922, the policy itself, closed).

Related: cloud#3668, cloud#4019, objectstack#30922.
